name: What is the typical process for bathroom drywall installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for bathroom drywall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with preparing the area, ensuring proper framing and electrical/plumbing rough-ins are complete. Next, drywall sheets are cut to size and securely fastened to the studs. After all sheets are hung, seams are taped with mesh or paper tape, followed by multiple layers of joint compound applied over the tape and screw heads. Each layer requires drying and sanding to achieve a smooth, seamless surface ready for priming and painting or tiling. Our team manages each step carefully for a durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves preparing the area, hanging drywall sheets, taping seams, and applying multiple coats of joint compound with drying and sanding.
